stages.name: Historical change inventory and evidence baseline
stages.goal: Index the entire Build #1 through Build #232 history, including failed/cancelled runs, commits, renames, deletions, original ownership and still-present behavior. This is NOT a last-build-only diff.
focus: Use Actions pagination and bounded compare windows, never a single capped 300-file comparison
Map build run -> SHA -> branch -> result -> affected paths; don't infer failure cause from conclusion alone
Build a deduplicated historical file inventory and current tracked-file inventory, including removed files
Identify historical changes plausibly regressing later builds without presuming causation
stages.stop: All run-number windows accounted for or explicitly marked unavailable; current files enumerated; comparison-truncation gaps named; NO production edits

stages.name: Installation, lifecycle, keyboard activation and MUL
stages.goal: Trace first-install/onboarding and host-extension launch to the actual first visible keyboard; review MUL, OS input mode, empty/incorrect board, fallback and native Globe as distinct gates.
focus: Inspect cold installation versus subsequent activation and app-to-keyboard state transfer
Distinguish primaryLanguage=mul from displayed preferred layout and iOS keyboard selection
Check reentry, duplicate initialization, owner identity, vanished views and inaccessible settings
Trace early historical introduction/removal of alternative boot paths
stages.stop: Every source-owned first-launch transition has owner, stale/cancel/retry path and test oracle; remaining iPhone-only checks marked not_run

stages.name: UIKit, SwiftUI, touch, haptics, sounds, native Emoji and UI
stages.goal: Inspect keyboard rendering, interaction ownership, event duplication, feedback persistence/fallback, system Globe/Emoji and accessibility across historical changes.
focus: Exactly one gesture/one character/one feedback; no duplicate UIKit/SwiftUI touch owners
CoreHaptics prewarm error, UIKit/Sensory fallback; persisted preference versus actual physical feedback
Native Globe tap/hold and actual Emoji History must not be conflated
Keyboard kind, symbol boundaries, dynamic height, first appearance and accessibility labels
stages.stop: Event and rendering owners mapped and line-level defects supported or dismissed; device-dependent findings not marked pass

stages.name: Mic session, audio, ASR/Live Dictation, native workers and memory
stages.goal: Inspect full model/audio lifecycle and every implicit cancellation/ownership gate from historical builds through cold Qwen repair.
focus: Warm/cold retries and host handshake verified by actual engine health, not stale flags
AVAudioSession resource release vs intentional arming; manual Stop, interruption and timeout
Native asynchronous load/unload/decode races, cancellation, memory pressure and safe fallback
Peak RAM, audio buffers, worker accounting, first-attempt Live and history recovery
stages.stop: Each endSession/suspend/unload/rearm caller and dependent state mapped; unmeasured memory issues labelled hypotheses

stages.name: Voice-to-host delivery, document ownership, LLM and output
stages.goal: Audit cross-process request identity, live/final transcription delivery, LLM transforms and exact host insertion safety.
focus: Prove original-document ownership before automatic insert; no unrelated field writes
Exactly-once delivery acknowledgment, stale token, cancellation and no-output retry
Documentless hosts and session/epoch recovery remain fail-closed
Undo/Redo, AI selected text, translation output, history and clipboard permissions
stages.stop: Delivery path has positive, foreign-field and interrupted cases; no invented host-specific runtime evidence

stages.name: App Group, preferences, settings, onboarding, storage and downloads
stages.goal: Audit all persistent settings and model/data lifecycle, including upgrades, resets, migrations, device reinstall and corruption recovery.
focus: Shared-defaults source of truth across app/extension; explicit OFF vs nil and cold cache
Haptic and sound chosen setting persists across keyboard controllers and app relaunch
Model-download cancel/retry, disk reserve, cleanup and mismatched generation
History/export/import/corrections/Emoji History/last-model preservation and reset impact
stages.stop: All discovered stored keys with destructive/reset/migration effect have owner and negative check

stages.name: Multilingual IME, suggestions, Cantonese variants, swipe and Emoji history
stages.goal: Review implementation and historical changes to Cantonese/English/German input, language priority, symbol/shapes, live suggestions and emoji state.
focus: MUL system language metadata vs actual user-visible language layout and preferences
Jyutping/Yale/Sidney Lau, HK colloquial traditional characters, fuzzy maps and exact candidate ownership
English/German suggestions and next-word suggestions after commits
Emoji catalog/history persistence versus native iOS Emoji keyboard picker
Swipe path touch ownership and off-by-one/gesture-trigger duplication
stages.stop: Language route and persistence state have test evidence or explicit device-only gap; earlier code variants considered

stages.name: Everything-else cross-domain audit and historical regressions
stages.goal: Sweep every unreviewed source path and cross-module seam including Meetings, Conversation, translation, ASR/AI models, privacy/diagnostics, performance, release config and unexplained historical regressions.
focus: Use coverage.json to find ALL unreviewed files; account for each as reviewed/excluded/not_reviewed
Check any implicit state gateway absent, not just ones in X1-X6
Speech/model sharing with meeting/conversation, audio capture, playback, LLM, export and failures
GitHub history, package dependencies, privacy, instrumentation, resource leaks and process termination
Reconcile historical source-only artifacts and stale docs with actual HEAD; no speculative false positives
stages.stop: Full current-file accounting, historical-changes ledger accounted; high-risk seams have verified defect/disposition, unresolved gaps recorded

stages.name: Verified root-cause repairs, tests and one unsigned TEST IPA
stages.goal: Prioritize confirmed findings across X0-X7, implement bounded root-cause repairs on fresh main, re-review with both lenses, and obtain a TEST unsigned IPA only when warranted.
focus: Predeclare weighted acceptance cases per real repair; critical/mandatory floors always block
Fix one canonical owner and immediate consumers, not layered workaround/version forks
Check main live HEAD and competing work; main only, no PR or merge, fast-forward only
New diagnostics when behavior changes; no private typing/audio, bounded App Group logging
Run cheapest regression gates first; build exactly one necessary TEST IPA if changes compile
stages.stop: All critical/high findings either fixed with evidence or explicitly blocked; score >=90 per completed repair and mandatory tests pass; iPhone acceptance remains separate

stages.name: Independent source reconciliation, release evidence and temporary review cleanup
stages.goal: Re-review X8 changes, verify every stage and artifact, get user-required iPhone evidence before acceptance, and delete temporary review folder only once blockers close.
focus: Independent fresh-context OCR-style and Untangle verification of repaired diffs; never self-certify independent agent
Verify matching source SHA/CI/artifact and App Group; preserve last usable IPA
Verify no critical/high unresolved issue and all mandatory >=90 acceptance cases (including human iPhone tests)
Present final in Chat; after gate success remove review folder from temp branch in ONE tree update and verify; branch deletion if supported
No cleanup if evidence needed to diagnose unresolved blocker
stages.stop: Review repository folder absent and cleanup confirmed, or explicit BLOCKED with retained evidence
